data.name: Samarthya
data.gender_notes: Samarthya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has the ability, strength, and skills to do something. The name Samarthya carries the meaning “Capable, Able, Skilled” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Samarthya usually hope their child will grow to embody capable, able, skilled and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength and abilities of an individual, and their potential to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Samarthya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Capable, Able, Skilled.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samarthya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: समर्थ्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: समर्थ्यता (samarthyata) - the quality of being able, competent, powerful, strong, valiant, or capable. समर्थ् (samartha) - capable, competent, strong, able, powerful.

in_hindi.name: समर्थ्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: शक्ति (shakti) - power, capability, strength. समर्थन (samarthan) - support, assistance. कौशल्य (kausalya) - skill, expertise, dexterity.

in_tamil.name: சமர்த்ய
in_tamil.long_meaning: உதவியம் (uthaviyam) - capability, power, ability. கொட்டம் (kottam) - wealth, resources. வியர்த்தியம் (viyarthiyam) - competence, expertise. அமைப்பு (amippu) - power, strength. விருத்தம் (viruttam) - ability, capability.

in_telugu.name: సమర్థ్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: శక్తి (shakti) - power, capability, strength. పొద్దు (puddhu) - wealth, resources. మొదేదే (modhade) - assistance, support. శశ్యట్టు (shashyathu) - competence, expertise. సీమేజోళే (simhajolene) - lion-hearted, brave.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Samarthya" is rooted in the Sanskrit language, which is a significant part of Hindu culture. The name connotes the idea of being capable, strong, and skilled in one's actions. This name can inspire individuals to strive for excellence in their personal and professional pursuits, as well as reflect the cultural values that place importance on individual abilities and accomplishments. Moreover, the name Samarthya could be seen as a reminder of the infinite potential within each person, encouraging individuals to reach for their highest potential.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name "Samarthya" can be seen as reflecting the divine aspect of being empowered and capable of overcoming challenges. The name reflects the belief that one has the inner strength and power to overcome obstacles and challenges, and that ultimately comes from a deeper connection to the divine. The spiritual significance of the name may encourage individuals to reflect on their inner strengths and the source of that power, leading them to a deeper sense of self-awareness and connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Samarthya: The name Samarthya signifies one who is fully competent, accomplished and endowed with infinite knowledge and power. It symbolizes the inner strength and courage to overcome all obstacles on the spiritual path.

historical_references.reference: Samarth Ramdas, also known as Samarth Ram, was a 17th-century Hindu saint, philosopher and social reformer from Maharashtra, India. He is considered an incarnation of god Sai Baba. Samarth Ramdas was a contemporary of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of Maratha Empire. He influenced Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in the formation of a Hindu military and political power in the Deccan region.
historical_references.context: Samarth Ramdas lived during the period of the emergence of the Maratha Empire in India.

historical_references.reference: Samartha Madhva, also known as Anubhavamurti, was a 13th-century Hindu philosopher, teacher and author from Udupi in Karnataka, India. He is considered a major figure in the Dvaita tradition of Indian philosophy and is known for his commentaries on works of Bhagavata Purana and his own work, 'Anubhavamrita'. He is also recognized for his contributions to the Kanada language and literature.
historical_references.context: Samartha Madhva lived during the medieval period and is recognized for his contributions to Indian philosophy and literature.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Samarthya continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
